entries.text: Aaand here we are.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_01

entries.text: Hey, are you sure this is a good idea?\nYou know, ’cause...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_01

entries.text: ...’Cause of Kieran? Nah, don’t worry. He won’t\nshow up here anytime soon.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_02

entries.text: If you say so...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_02

entries.text: Anyway, this is the base of operations for the\nLeague Club![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_03

entries.text: On behalf of the whole club: Glad you’re here![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_24

entries.text: What’s this League Club?
entries.label: sdc02_0089_select_01

entries.text: What does the club do?
entries.label: sdc02_0089_select_02

entries.text: Heh heh. Glad you asked![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_04

entries.text: We Blueberry Academy students have our own\nPokémon battle ranking system: the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]BB League[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_05

entries.text: Here in the League Club, we battle each other\nto train up so we can climb the ranks.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_06

entries.text: We win, we lose, we have a good ol’ rowdy time.\nSuch is our humble club in a nutshell![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_07

entries.text: You’re not wrong, but seriously? That’s how you\nexplain it to new people?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_03

entries.text: Yup. Though I guess we’re having less of a good\nol’ rowdy time than usual lately.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_08

entries.text: I’m a member of the club too. I don’t show up to\nthe clubroom very much, though.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_04

entries.text: Just FYI, the top four Pokémon Trainers in the\nBB League are called the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]BB League Elite Four[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_05

entries.text: And this annoying toothpaste-haired bozo is one\nof them. So is that girl you saw with me at the\r\nTerarium earlier.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_06

entries.text: Too bad you didn’t make the cut, Carmine.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_09

entries.text: I’ve just been too busy with extracurricular\nstuff! Haven’t had time for League matches.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_07

entries.text: If we’re talking actual skill, I’m WAY above any\nof the Elite Four![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_08

entries.text: Heh heh. That’s no lie.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_10

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Whatcha think, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?
Fun
club,
huh?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_11

entries.text: Oooh, I can feel the enthusiasm! That’s what I’m\ntalkin’ about![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_12

entries.text: I have a feeling you’re more into the idea than\nyou’re letting on![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_13

entries.text: Aaanyway, think that takes care of it. You’re in—\non a trial basis![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_14

entries.text: Huh? What do you mean, “trial basis”?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_09

entries.text: You heard me! Far as the Drayster’s concerned,\nwe’re clubmates now! Trial-basis clubmates![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_15

entries.text: So now you can use this clubroom freely, and do\nwhatever with the stuff here.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_16

entries.text: Check out the computer over there, too. It’s\nsuper helpful.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_17

entries.text: It lets you use your BP to support kids in other\nclubs. They’ll return the favor in different ways.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_18

entries.text: Here—give it a shot, and you’ll see what I mean.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_25

entries.text: You received [VAR 0x0204(0001,0000)] BP from Drayton!
entries.label: sdc02_0089_system_01

entries.text: Try sending that to Mitch in the baseball club.\nHe can help you out with your throwing form.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_26

entries.text: Where you going? You gotta use the computer\nand send Mitch some BP.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_stopper

entries.text: Use the computer to help Mitch out with some\nBP. Just give it a shot, and you’ll see what I mean.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_npc

entries.text: It looks like Drayton’s set on you doing this. Just\nplay along, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_npc

entries.text: Oh, whoa—you did it.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_27

entries.text: Not bad for your first time. That’ll teach me to\ndoubt your skills![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_28

entries.text: Here, I’ve got a really nice present for you—from\none charming catch to another![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_30

entries.text: You can have this too. Put it on, and you’ll look\njust like the Drayster![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_31

entries.text: You received the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]League Club Uniform[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from\nDrayton!
entries.label: sdc02_0089_system_02

entries.text: Anyway, feel free to computer it up any way you\nwant! Like I said, we’re trial-basis clubmates now.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_29

entries.text: And that’s not all! For a limited time, you can\nhave as many of these snacks as you want![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_19

entries.text: Those snacks are all yours, Drayton—snacks you\nleave around opened and half-finished.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_10

entries.text: I wouldn’t go near any of ’em. Who knows how\nlong they’ve been sitting around.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_11

entries.text: All that explaining left me starving.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_20

entries.text: Think I’m gonna head on over to the cafeteria.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_21

entries.text: If you wanna officially join us, maybe we can\nhave a cafeteria date to talk details![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_22

entries.text: Be seein’ ya![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_23

entries.text: Aaagh! That bozo! Seriously, what is his problem?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_13

entries.text: And a cafeteria date? What does he even mean\nby that?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_14

entries.text: Calm down, Carmine
entries.label: sdc02_0089_select_03

entries.text: Well, a date is...
entries.label: sdc02_0089_select_04

entries.text: Just so you know, this is not excitement over the\ndate thing. It’s anger.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_15

entries.text: No, I KNOW what a date is... Were you seriously\nabout to explain it to me?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_16

entries.text: *sigh* Sorry. Being in here puts me on edge.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_17

entries.text: Let’s go somewhere else.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_18

entries.text: Someplace people won’t bother us... I know!\nLet’s go to your room.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_19

entries.text: You don’t know where your room is? Just wander\naround, and you’ll find it eventually.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_20
